title: GetActionItemsRequest
description: Request body for getting action items with optional filters and pagination.

order_by.description: Sort order for action items. Valid values: 'created_at_desc' (default, newest first), 'created_at_asc' (oldest first), 'updated_at_desc' (most recently updated first), 'updated_at_asc' (least recently updated first), 'due_date' (soonest due date first, items without due dates appear last)

created_at_start.description: Only return action items created at or after this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO datetime, and is inclusive. A value without a time means midnight UTC, so an end bound of 2024-01-05 excludes everything later that day.
created_at_start.title: Created At Start

created_at_end.description: Only return action items created at or before this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO datetime, and is inclusive. A value without a time means midnight UTC, so an end bound of 2024-01-05 excludes everything later that day.
created_at_end.title: Created At End

updated_at_start.description: Only return action items updated at or after this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO datetime, and is inclusive. A value without a time means midnight UTC, so an end bound of 2024-01-05 excludes everything later that day. Whether updated_at moves depends on where the change was made. Edits in the note itself, including its text, completion, assignees and due date, all bump updated_at. An assignee or due date changed outside the note, such as from the action items list, is written to a separate record and leaves updated_at unchanged, so this filter does not pick that item up.
updated_at_start.title: Updated At Start

updated_at_end.description: Only return action items updated at or before this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO datetime, and is inclusive. A value without a time means midnight UTC, so an end bound of 2024-01-05 excludes everything later that day. Whether updated_at moves depends on where the change was made. Edits in the note itself, including its text, completion, assignees and due date, all bump updated_at. An assignee or due date changed outside the note, such as from the action items list, is written to a separate record and leaves updated_at unchanged, so this filter does not pick that item up.
updated_at_end.title: Updated At End

ActionItemOrderBy.title: ActionItemOrderBy
